tag.name: recon
tag.description: Reconcile what a test submitted (expect) with what it saw processed (confirm), matched by count per key - the whole value, or its last N characters (suffix=) so full values meet masked ones: records outstanding and unexpected, groups short, over or reconciled by count with their candidates, processing lag, and a pass/fail gate.

get.summary: Record a value the test submitted
get.description: Records that the test submitted a record (the expected side). Every call is one record - or POST many. Records are counted per match key: a key expected 3 times needs 3 confirmations, and nothing is deduplicated. With suffix=N on the key's first write, the match key is the last N characters, so full values here can meet masked ones on the confirmed side; the full values are kept as candidates.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Caller-chosen reconciliation set (a test run, a batch). 1-128 characters: letters, digits and . _ - : @ + =, starting with a letter, digit or +. Case-sensitive.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: One record: the value that identifies it - an email address, an order or case number, a reference token. Trimmed; up to 1000 bytes. Required for a GET; for a POST send the values as the body instead. Records are matched by COUNT on their match key: the whole value (case-sensitive unless ignorecase=true), or its last N characters when the key was created with suffix=N. A value sent twice is two records.

parameters.name: value64
parameters.description: The match value as base64 (standard or URL-safe). Use it for values containing + & % # - e.g. jane+test@example.com.

parameters.name: ignorecase
parameters.description: Match values case-insensitively (Jane@X.com = jane@x.com). The FIRST write to a key fixes this for the life of the key; a later write that asks for the other setting is a 400. Default false.

parameters.name: suffix
parameters.description: Match on the last N characters (0-64) instead of the whole value, so the expected side can send full values (609829094) and the confirmed side masked ones (xxxxx9094 or 9094). The values given are kept as candidates. The FIRST write to a key fixes this; a later write that asks for another N is a 400. Default 0: whole values.

parameters.name: perfkey
parameters.description: A perf key: each record this call pairs (an expectation meets a confirmation) records its processing lag as a perf/add point - ms from the match key's first expectation, 0 if the confirmation came first - so perf/stats, perf/series and perf/assert work on it.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Example record field. Any parameter not listed here is a field (name lower-cased, value trimmed; an empty value means not given). The first record on each side keeps its fields. Fields given on both sides are compared only when the match key is unique on both sides (1 vs 1), where the pairing is certain; numbers compare as numbers (120.00 = 120).

suffix.description: The key's matching rule: 0 = whole values.

match.description: The match key it was counted under.

previousStatus.description: The group's state before this record; null for a new key.

expected.description: The group's expected count after this record.

latencyMs.description: Present when this record paired an expectation with a confirmation.

differences.description: Fields that disagree (only in a mismatched group).

x-free-form-query.description: Every query parameter other than key, value, value64, ignorecase, suffix and perfkey is stored as a field of this side of the record (names lower-cased). wait, strict, grace, sla, fields, status, start, limit and format are reserved (400).

get.summary: Reconciliation counts, or one value's state
get.description: Without value: the counts for the key, in records - expected, confirmed, matched (paired), outstanding (total shortfall), unexpected (total overage), mismatched - plus how many groups are in each state, ambiguousGroups, the processing lag and reconciled. Read from running counters (one BatchGetItem, however many records), or with fields= judged again from every group. With value: the group that value falls under. wait= holds the request until nothing is outstanding; strict=true makes "not reconciled" a 412. A key nothing was written to has expected 0 and is never reconciled, so an empty run cannot pass a gate.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Caller-chosen reconciliation set (a test run, a batch). 1-128 characters: letters, digits and . _ - : @ + =, starting with a letter, digit or +. Case-sensitive.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Report the group this value falls under instead of the counts (404 if its key was never expected or confirmed, unless wait= is given).

parameters.name: value64
parameters.description: The match value as base64 (standard or URL-safe). Use it for values containing + & % # - e.g. jane+test@example.com.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds (0-20) to hold the request open until no record is outstanding (with value=: until that key is no longer short). Default 0. Out of time is still a 200 with the counts as they are.

parameters.name: strict
parameters.description: true: answer 412 (same body) unless reconciled is true - so a pipeline step can fail on the status code alone. Default false.

parameters.name: grace
parameters.description: Seconds. Unexpected records in groups that went over within this many seconds are reported as withinGrace and do not stop reconciled being true: in a load test a confirmation can land before its expectation is written.

parameters.name: sla
parameters.description: Seconds. Adds overdue: outstanding records in short groups first expected more than this long ago.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names that must agree in a 1-vs-1 group: each must be present on BOTH sides and equal, or the group is mismatched. Re-judges every group from the groups themselves (source: scan, up to 50,000 groups, with latency percentiles) instead of the running counters.

matched.description: Records paired: the sum over keys of min(expected, confirmed).

outstanding.description: Records expected and not confirmed: the total shortBy.

unexpected.description: Records confirmed and not expected: the total overBy.

ambiguousGroups.description: Groups where more than one record shares the key on either side: how much of the result rests on counting rather than exact pairing.

groups.description: How many groups (match keys) are in each state.

latencyMs.description: Processing lag of paired records, ms. Percentiles only with fields= (source: scan).

reconciled.description: Something was expected, nothing is outstanding or mismatched, and nothing is unexpected (beyond grace).

expiresTime.description: When the key's data is deleted (30 days after its first write).

match.description: The match key the value falls under.

exists.description: false only with wait= (without it an unknown key is a 404).

group.description: One match key and every record that shares it.

value.description: The match key (with suffix=N, the last N characters).

candidates.description: The values the expected side gave under this key (up to 100). For a short group with several, one of them is missing - which one cannot be told.

confirmedValues.description: The values the confirmed side gave, when they are not all among the candidates (e.g. masked ones).

latencyMs.description: First confirmation minus first expectation, ms (negative: a confirmation came first).

expectedFields.description: Fields as given by the first record on this side.

confirmedFields.description: Fields as given by the first record on this side.

differences.description: Fields that disagree (only in a mismatched group).

reconciled.description: true when the group is matched or reconciledByCount.

get.description: Groups (match keys) with one status, unreconciled (short, over and mismatched: the values still to reconcile), or all - oldest in their state first; for short, the one recon/cyclepop handed out least recently first. Each has its counts, shortBy or overBy, the candidates, the lag and, when mismatched, the differences. format=csv for a report. With fields= every group is judged again against those fields.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Caller-chosen reconciliation set (a test run, a batch). 1-128 characters: letters, digits and . _ - : @ + =, starting with a letter, digit or +. Case-sensitive.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: matched, mismatched, reconciledByCount, short, over, unreconciled (short + over + mismatched) or all (default). Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First record to return, 1-based. start + limit may reach 10,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Records to return, 1-1000 (default 100).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default) or csv: value, status, expected, confirmed, shortBy, overBy, candidates, confirmedValues, expectedTime, confirmedTime, latencyMs, differences, then expected.<field> / confirmed.<field> for the fields on the page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names that must agree in a 1-vs-1 group: each must be present on BOTH sides and equal, or the group is mismatched. Re-judges every group from the groups themselves (source: scan, up to 50,000 groups, with latency percentiles) instead of the running counters.

items.description: One match key and every record that shares it.

value.description: The match key (with suffix=N, the last N characters).

candidates.description: The values the expected side gave under this key (up to 100). For a short group with several, one of them is missing - which one cannot be told.

confirmedValues.description: The values the confirmed side gave, when they are not all among the candidates (e.g. masked ones).

latencyMs.description: First confirmation minus first expectation, ms (negative: a confirmation came first).

expectedFields.description: Fields as given by the first record on this side.

confirmedFields.description: Fields as given by the first record on this side.

differences.description: Fields that disagree (only in a mismatched group).

get.summary: The next short key to check
get.description: The short group handed out least recently; handing it out moves it to the back, so concurrent checkers each get a different one and every short key comes round in turn. Not consuming: it stays short until enough confirmations arrive. For a checker that looks each one up in the system under test.
